mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Jhin made Hwei into his virtuosic magnum opus, earning %i:scaleAPen% 4.444 Lethality.

“Our fourth and final act draws to a close. The painter falls, and I arise the maestro of death.”

Hwei fell to Jhin's machinations, making Hwei unable to reach his full potential.

“Was I always meant to fall to Jhin? Was there any hope? I… I…”

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Jhin places an invisible lotus trap that blooms when walked over. It slows nearby enemies before dealing damage with an explosion of serrated petals.

Beauty in Death - When Jhin kills an enemy champion, a lotus trap will bloom near their corpse.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Champions Jhin kills will create and detonate a Lotus Trap at their location.

Active: Jhin places an invisible Lotus Trap for @TrapDuration@ minutes that creates a zone that Slows by @TrapSlowAmount*100@% when stepped on by an enemy. After @TrapDetonationTime@ seconds, the trap detonates, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

This ability has 2 charges (@AmmoRechargeRateTooltip@ second refresh).
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Lotus Trap hits deal @ReducedDamagePercent*100@% damage to minions, and enemies recently hit by another Lotus Trap.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Lotus Trap</titleLeft><mainText>This trap activates when stepped on, revealing and slowing everything nearby before exploding in a flurry of serrated petals.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Shredding Petals</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been slowed by one of Jhin's traps and will take massive damage if it sticks around.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

Whisper
Death in 4 Acts - Jhin's hand cannon has a fixed attack speed (@f5@) and can be fired 4 times before needing to be reloaded. The 4th bullet always crits and deals bonus damage equal to @f9@% of the target's missing health.

Every Moment Matters - Critical Strike Chance and Bonus Attack Speed have special scaling:
  • Attack Damage is increased by @f8@ (@f2@% (+@f4@%) (+@f3@%) of total AD).
  • Jhin's Crits deal @f10@% reduced damage but grant him @f15@% (+@f6@%) Move Speed for 2 seconds.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Jhin's hand cannon has a fixed Attack Speed and can be fired @MaxAmmo@ times before needing to be reloaded. The @MaxAmmo@th shot always critically strikes, and deals an additional @FourthShotExecutePercent@ missing health physical damage.

In addition:
  • Jhin gains @TotalADPercent@ bonus Attack Damage
  • Jhin's critical strikes deal @CritReductionPercent*100@% less damage but grant him @CritMoveSpeedPercent@ Move Speed for @HasteDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_JhinPassive_Tooltip}}
Attack Damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and bonus Attack Speed.
Move Speed scales with bonus Attack Speed.
Missing health damage is capped at 800 against monsters.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Finale</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's next attack will crit and deal bonus execute damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Perfection!</titleLeft><mainText>This unit recently crit and has increased Move Speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Jhin launches a magical cartridge at an enemy. It can hit up to four targets and gains damage each time it kills.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Jhin launches a cartridge that deals @TotalDamage@ physical damage before bouncing to a nearby enemy that has not been hit yet.

The cartridge can hit a maximum of @TooltipMaxTargetsHit@ times. Enemies that die shortly after being hit increase the damage of subsequent hits by @PercentAmpOnKill*100@%.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Jhin channels, transforming Whisper into a shoulder-mounted mega-cannon. It is able to fire 4 super shots at extreme range that pierce through minions and monsters, but stop on the first champion impacted. Whisper cripples enemies hit, which slows them and deals execute damage. The 4th shot is perfectly crafted, epically powerful, and guaranteed to critically strike.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Jhin sets up and channels, enabling him to fire 4 super shots, each dealing between <physicalDamage>@DamageCalc@</physicalDamage> and <physicalDamage>@MaxIncreaseCalc@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to the first champion hit based on their percentage missing health and <status>Slowing</status> them by @SlowPercent*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds. The fourth shot critically strikes for @FourthShotMultiplier*100@% damage.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Caught Out</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been revealed by Jhin's traps or ultimate.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Crippled</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been massively slowed by one of Jhin's super shots.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Jhin brandishes his cane, firing a single shot with incredible range. It pierces through minions and monsters, but stops on the first champion hit. If the target was recently struck by Jhin's allies, lotus traps, or damaged by Jhin, they are rooted.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Jhin fires a long range shot dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage to the first champion hit and other enemies along the way.

If this skill strikes a champion that has been damaged by an allied champion within the last @SpottingDuration@ seconds, it will Root them for @RootDuration@ seconds and grant Jhin Whisper's Move Speed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
This ability deals @MinionMod*100@% damage to minions.
Champions that step on a trap from Captive Audience can also be rooted.
